mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, name, description, config, metadata, scope, provider, resolved_template, created_at, updated_at, archived_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO environments ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, name, description, config, metadata, scope, provider, resolved_template, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Description}, CAST(#{params.Config,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Metadata,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.Scope}, #{params.Provider}, #{params.ResolvedTemplate}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE environments SET name = #{params.Name}, description = #{params.Description}, config = CAST(#{params.Config,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), metadata = CAST(#{params.Metadata,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), scope = #{params.Scope}, resolved_template = #{params.ResolvedTemplate}, updated_at = #{params.UpdatedAt} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING
UPDATE environments SET archived_at = COALESCE(archived_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM environments
workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND archived_at IS NULL
AND (created_at, uuid) < (#{params.Cursor.CreatedAt}, #{params.Cursor.UUID})
ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC LIMIT #{params.FetchLimit}
